write_up: This is a strong senior payments resume. At Tidewater Commerce, you show the systems you built, how they perform, and what changed. Your earlier billing work reinforces the same story. A recruiter can see both technical depth and leadership without having to guess.

The Northwind invoice-generation line is a great model: it names the change you made and puts the time saved in concrete terms. Your headline matches the work, and your current role leads the experience section.

Your resume is ready to send and isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a call back. How competitive a particular role is will still matter. If you're aiming above senior, you can also bring forward a decision that shaped the wider payments system.
